findings.value: A free, not-for-profit contemporary art gallery run by Bow Arts, which hosts the East London Art Prize shortlist and winner's shows in alternate years.

evidence.quote: The Nunnery Gallery is a not-for-profit, free, contemporary art space.
The Nunnery Gallery hosts the shortlist and winner’s exhibitions on alternate years.

notes: The venue's own Bow Arts page is the only source read. No named-publication review was found in the searches (the search budget ran out). A Hackney Citizen tag page and a Time Out listing for Bow Arts came up in search but were not read. Outer zone; the editor should keep worth_the_trip.
